1.description: Increased the spell damage coefficient of Arcane Missiles to 18%, from 15.7%.
Ambush now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Fireball now deals 5% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Arcane Missiles now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 5%.
Hamstring now deals 10% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Hunter pet auto attacks now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 30%.

Clarified the tooltip of Taste for Blood to indicate that the RE Insatiable replaces the damage increase of 10% and changes it to 20% per stack, not additive with the original Taste of Blood damage increase.
Clarified the tooltip of Consecration to more accurately show the damage of the actual spell.
Clarified the tooltip of Healing Focus to specify it only gives spell haste.
Fixed an issue causing Primal Fury to not always award an extra combo point on dealing a critical strike with Cat combo point generators.
Fixed an issue where Fel Intelligence wouldn't stack with Divine Spirit.
Fixed an issue causing Faerie Fire and Sting (hunter pet) to not be removed with immunities like Cloak of Shadows or Divine Shield.
Fixed an issue where Shadowfury would consume charges of Backdraft.

Fixed an issue where Shield Slam would not trigger its dispel effect when Sword and Board is active. [Pending server restart]

5.description: Fixed Skill Card - Recuperate to no longer be broken. Pending Restart.

0.description: Pending restart, fixed spelling error on Missile Barrage talent.

7.description: Fixed an issue where Fire Fire Fireball dealt too much damage at low levels. Its base damage will now properly scale with your level, and will be lower than previously for players level 50 and below, and slightly higher for high level players. [This change requires a restart.]

8.description: Moved all Mystic Scroll quests to Nozdormu.

5.description: Libram of Repentance will now properly work with the Holy Shield from the Crimson Champion legendary enchant.

7.description: Fixed an issue where the Divine damage Arcane Missiles from the Prophet of Wrath legendary didn't have the same spell damage coefficient as normal Arcane Missiles.
Fixed a bug where the effect of Hailstorm would end when hitting a target in stealth.
Ice Barrage now increases the damage of Ice Lance against higher level targets by 50%, up from 33%.
Corrected the tooltip of Stupefied to show the correct cast speed slow and duration.
Fixed an issue with Druid of Rot: Call Fungarians where the original Force of Nature was still castable while the RE was equipped.
Fixed a strange interaction between Evocation and Arcane Missiles (Divine) which could cause players to deal damage to themselves.
Fixed an issue with Prison Tactics not being consumed by Mutilate. Also clarified that Shiv does not benefit from the RE.
Fixed an issue where the Improved Traps enchant wasn't functioning correctly.
Fixed an issue with Blooming Growth, it will now apply even if the chained targets are more than 35 yards away from the caster.
Increased the cooldown reduction of Channeled Rage RE to 3 seconds, up from 1 second. In addition, spell critical now extend the duration by 3 seconds, up from 2 seconds.
Expunge explosion now uses ranged hit/crit instead of spell hit/crit percent chance values.
Fixed an issue where the Wild Quiver enchant sometimes gave less of a pro chance increase to the Wild Quiver talent than intended.
Fixed an issue causing Evoker to sometimes stop working until relog.
Fixed an issue where effects meant to increase the duration of your debuff on a target sometimes incorrectly would affect another players' debuff of the same kind instead of yours.

[New Epic Enchant] - Fire Fire Fireball: After casting Fireball twice, your next Fireball's cast time will be increased by 0.5 seconds but will additionally trigger a wave of Fireballs towards your current target. In addition, the critical strike chance of Fireball is increased by 6%.

New Legendary enchant: Primordial Fury - During Shamanistic Rage your Shaman non-periodic spell and ability criticals consume 50 rage to deal extra Elemental damage and empower you with Primordial Fury, increasing your spell damage by 30% of your Agility for 15 seconds. (Elemental damage is a combination of the Nature, Fire and Frost schools, and will benefit from the highest modifier to either of these schools.)

New Legendary enchant: Crimson Champion - Your Holy Shield ability is transformed into Holy Shield (Crimson Champion) which permanently increases your chance to block by 10% and deals Holy damage when blocking an attack. This damage can only occur once per second, and instead of consuming a charge of the buff it instead grants one. Three charges are consumed to empower your next Shield Slam, Avenger's Shield or Power Word: Shield:

 Shield Slam - Deals Holy damage to all nearby enemies. 

Avenger's Shield - Increases your block value by 15% and threat by 10% for 10 sec. 

Power Word: Shield - Reduces all damage taken by 50% for 2 seconds.
New Epic enchant: Controlled Typhoon - Your Typhoon no longer knocks enemies back. It instead knocks you back.
New Epic enchant: Controlled Blast - Your Blast Wave no longer knocks enemies back. Instead its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds and mana cost by 50%.

New Epic enchant: Controlled Storm - Your Thunderstorm no longer knocks enemies back. It instead restores twice as much mana and infuses you with lightning, increasing your critical strike chance with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 15% for 10 seconds.
New Epic enchant: Rekindled Faith - Each time your Renew heals a target with full health the duration of the Renew effect on the target is increased by 2 sec.
New Rare enchant: Honor Among Thieves - Reduces the internal cooldown of your Honor Among Thieves Capstone effect by 0.5s.

New Epic enchant: Avatar of Lightning - Your Elemental Mastery now frees you from the physical plane, lifting you into the air and allowing you to move while casting Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. The cooldown of your Elemental Mastery is also halved, but it no longer gives you an instant cast.

6.description: Corrected an issue where the Maiden of Virtue would attack the target of Blessing of Martyrdom at the end of the cast if the target was in melee range. Active after server restart.

Fixed an issue causing Stoneclaw Totem not to generate any threat.

Fixed a bug where Presence of Mind couldn't be used while Arcane Power was active.
Fixed a bug where Earth and Moon could trigger the Predatory Strikes talent. [Pending server restart]
